labelBasis: fixed behavioral assertions plus independent code review; not model self-grading
holdoutVisibility: public; partition only, not a blind holdout

cases.contract: Inputs now and expires are finite Python int/float timestamps: no NaN, infinities or custom comparison types. A session is expired exactly when now is greater than or equal to expires.
cases.before:
def expired(now, expires):
    return now >= expires
cases.after:
def expired(now, expires):
    return now > expires

cases.contract: Fits means the UTF-8 encoded byte length is no greater than the byte budget.
cases.before:
def fits(text, budget):
    return len(text.encode("utf-8")) <= budget
cases.after:
def fits(text, budget):
    return len(text) <= budget

defect.claim: Multibyte text can exceed the byte budget.

cases.contract: Use the fallback only when value is None; preserve false, zero and empty values.
cases.before:
def select(value, fallback):
    return fallback if value is None else value
cases.after:
def select(value, fallback):
    return value or fallback

defect.claim: A supplied false value is replaced by the fallback.
